text: וְתוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וּמָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖יךָ עִמּ֑וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֗ר לְגֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙
translation: prospered, and your kin, being in straits, comes under that one’s authority and is given over to the resident
parts: וְתוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וּמָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖יךָ עִמּ֑וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֗ר לְגֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙

text: עִמָּ֔ךְ א֥וֹ לְעֵ֖קֶר מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת גֵּֽר׃ אַחֲרֵ֣י נִמְכַּ֔ר גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶה־
translation: alien among you, or to an offshoot of an alien’s family, [your kin] shall have the right of redemption even after having been

translation: given over. [Typically,] a brother shall do the redeeming, or an uncle or an uncle’s son shall do the redeeming—anyone in the

text: מִשְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖וֹ
translation: family who is of the same flesh shall do the redeeming; or, having prospered, [your formerly impoverished kin] may do
parts: מִשְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖וֹ

text: וְנִגְאָֽל׃ וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת
translation: the redeeming. The total shall be computed with the purchaser as from the year of being given over to the other
parts: וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת

text: הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר
translation: until the jubilee year; the price of sale shall be applied to the number of years, as though it were for a term as a hired laborer
parts: הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר

translation: under the other’s authority. If many years remain, [your kin] shall pay back for the redemption in proportion
parts: אִם־ע֥וֹד רַבּ֖וֹת בַּשָּׁנִ֑ים לְפִיהֶן֙ יָשִׁ֣יב גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ

translation: to the purchase price; and if few years remain until the jubilee year, so shall it be

translation: computed: payment shall be made for the redemption according to the years involved. One shall be under

translation: the other’s authority as a laborer hired by the year; the other shall not rule ruthlessly in your sight.
parts: שָׁנָ֛ה בְּשָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יִרְדֶּ֥נּֽוּ בְּפֶ֖רֶךְ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ

translation: If not redeemed in any of those ways, that person, along with any children, shall go free in the

translation: jubilee For it is to Me that the Israelites are servants: they are My

text: הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
translation: servants, whom I freed from the land of Egypt—I, your God יהוה.
parts: הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

translation: You shall not make idols for yourselves, or set up for yourselves

translation: worship upon, for I יהוה am your You shall keep My sabbaths and

translation: venerate My sanctuary, Mine, יהוה’s.

text: אִם־בְּחֻקֹּתַ֖י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתַ֣י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם
translation: If you follow My laws and faithfully observe My commandments,

text: אֹתָֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ
translation: I will grant your rains in their season, so that the earth shall yield its produce
parts: וְנָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵיכֶ֖ם בְּעִתָּ֑ם וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔הּ

text: וְעֵ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽוֹ׃ וְהִשִּׂ֨יג לָכֶ֥ם דַּ֙יִשׁ֙ אֶת־בָּצִ֔יר
translation: and the trees of the field their fruit. Your threshing shall overtake the vintage,

text: וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע
translation: and your vintage shall overtake the sowing; you shall eat your fill of
parts: וּבָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת־זָ֑רַע וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְכֶם֙ לָשֹׂ֔בַע

text: וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃ וְנָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ
translation: bread and dwell securely in your land. I will grant peace in the land,

text: וּשְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ
translation: and you shall lie down untroubled by anyone; I will give the land respite from vicious

text: וְחֶ֖רֶב לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּאַרְצְכֶֽם׃ וּרְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶ֑ם
translation: beasts, and no sword shall cross your land. [Your army] shall give chase to your enemies,

translation: and they shall fall before you by the sword. Five of you shall give chase to a hundred, and

translation: a hundred of you shall give chase to ten thousand; your enemies shall fall before you by

translation: the sword. I will look with favor upon you, and make you fertile and multiply

translation: you; and I will maintain My covenant with you. You shall eat old grain long stored,

text: נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְיָשָׁ֕ן מִפְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ׃ וְנָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י
translation: and you shall have to clear out the old to make room for the new. I will establish My

translation: abode in your midst, and I will not spurn you. I will be ever

translation: present in your midst: I will be your God, and you shall be My people.

translation: But if you do not obey Me and do not observe all these

translation: the body to languish; you shall sow your seed to no purpose, for your enemies

translation: and your foes shall dominate you. You shall flee though none pursues.
parts: וְרָד֤וּ בָכֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵיכֶ֔ם וְנַסְתֶּ֖ם וְאֵין־רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְכֶֽם
